# Build in source tree.
set(BINARY_DIR ${SOURCE_DIR})

list(APPEND INSTALL_CMD COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different certifi/cacert.pem ${OUTPUT_DIR}/data/ca-bundle.crt)

external_project(
    DOWNLOAD URL 72f17c6a4aaeef351eec2f8fef2b3f3c
    https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/6d/39/5eec3296860b94ac20bb8ed807725b88f6adfab3f343df592afd975f5f86/certifi-2026.11.20-py3-none-any.whl
    INSTALL_COMMAND ${INSTALL_CMD}
)
